macro.text: Oil headed for a weekly gain as Gulf and Hormuz attacks threatened supply recovery
Russia intensified strikes on Ukraine's energy grid as Trump and NATO urged restraint
Dollar held near recent highs, on track for a third straight monthly gain
Gold steadied near a 15-month low as hot PCE data revived Fed rate-hike bets
Fed rate-hike bets firmed after sticky PCE inflation, cooling the global bond rally
US Q3 GDP growth was revised up sharply to 4.3%, prompting Trump to demand a probe

corporate.note: S&P flagged Nvidia for a possible one-notch credit downgrade on governance risk
New BIS rule bars buyers from renting GPUs to Chinese customers, stalling Asia data center deals
UBS faces a parliamentary showdown over tougher capital rules even as FINMA backed its crisis plan
Japan Tobacco shares surged on a report Imperial Brands is weighing a takeover approach
Norse Atlantic suspended all flights and warned it may file for bankruptcy
Friedman Industries CEO bought roughly $169,000 of company stock
Granite Ridge Resources CFO bought about $27,000 of company stock
Huron Consulting director sold roughly $83,000 of company stock

frontPage.watch: Thin post-holiday liquidity with oil and the dollar firm, gold soft, and Nvidia headlines (credit watch, chip-curb fallout) in focus.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3747 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.840 + 0.973×ln(VIX) + 0.315×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
